findings.desc: packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:34 and packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:68 document the global fallback as `KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex koala ...`, but packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1004-1007 only logs read-only commands when `KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1`. That means the documented fallback `session_brief` path still produces no activity heartbeat/session record, contradicting .Codex/README/manifest guidance and leaving Codex users without the read-only logging this story is meant to harden. Include `KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1` in the fallback entry/docs or make `KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex` imply the read-only opt-in for Codex fallback sessions.

.Codex/README.md:3-16 says the generic Codex entrypoint is KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex koala and says to switch to node bin/koala-codex.js only if the repository later adds a local wrapper, but this story/repo already includes bin/koala-codex.js and .Codex/koala.json lists local-wrapper first. WHY: user-facing Codex guidance contradicts README.md:39-55 and the adapter manifest, so Codex users can keep using the less capable global fallback and miss aux_* bootstrap support. severity=medium

packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:34 and packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:68 expose the global Codex fallback as `KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex koala session_brief`, and .Codex/koala.json documents KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY separately. But packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1004-1007 only records read-only commands when KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1, so the documented fallback does not actually create the session_brief activity heartbeat that the adapter guidance promises. Either include KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1 in the fallback metadata/docs or make KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex imply read-only logging for Codex fallback calls.

scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs:34-55 verifies read-only session_brief heartbeat only through node bin/koala-codex.js, while packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:34 and .Codex/koala.json:12-20 also advertise the global fallback KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex koala with recordReadOnly documented separately. There is no test/evidence that the documented global fallback records a session_brief activity heartbeat, and cli-engine.ts:1004-1007 suggests read-only commands log only when KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1. Add coverage for the fallback heartbeat or update the manifest/docs and tests to require KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1 on that path.

.Codex/README.md:5-11 and packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:67-73 present the global Codex fallback as KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex koala session_brief and promise it writes source=codex activity, but packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1004-1007 suppresses read-only command logging unless KOALA_ACTIVITY_RECORD_READONLY=1. WHY: the Codex channel guidance/manifest boundary is internally inconsistent; users without the local wrapper get no session_brief heartbeat even though the adapter output says this fallback records Codex activity. severity=medium
